subject: CmdSTAN: backing up 'output.csv' after every N samples

messages.author: a7de39e424b27378
messages.subject: CmdSTAN: backing up 'output.csv' after every N samples
parts:
Dear STAN community,

I must be overlooking something in the manual; how can I ask CmdSTAN to
back up already collected samples every 1000-th iteration or so? Just in case
my computer crashes, so I do not lose a lot of already calculated samples...

Best regards,
Arseniy.

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] CmdSTAN: backing up 'output.csv' after every N samples
parts:
Hi Arseniy,

CmdStan writes out every iteration to disk, so it already does what you're asking for. If you thin, it'll only write the iterations you ask to save, but it'll do it after the iteration is done.

By default, CmdStan does not save warmup iterations. If your computer crashes during warmup, it won't save those.

Is CmdStan causing your computer to crash?



Daniel
